title: chore(pm): ensure-pm-labels stops seeding the lease:* labels

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuR8F5nRQPQ47C5tRSxaHjFv)_

Part of #35350

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：用户无感；建标签的脚本不再建那批「区名」标签。
- 为什么做：你同意不再用区名标签、改在认领评论里写区名；这一步保证标签删掉后不会被脚本重新建回来。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是脚本少建一类已经不用的标签，派发照常；可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

Card item 2, script half only. The ruling on the card (Bill, 2026-11-19 05:57Z, 「同意，立卡更新skills」): no more `lease:*` labels; the area name goes into the claim comment, with the assignee and the seat's area table; the old labels are deleted. Item 1 (the skill text) landed in PR #35363.

- `scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh`: removed the `lease:AREA` family block (the 18-line comment, the `for A in A1 A2 A3 A4 A5 E1 E2 E2b` loop and its `gh label create "lease:$A"` line; lines 433-453 at base a186b2b584). A default or `--reconcile` run of the script no longer recreates `lease:A1`-`A5`, `E1`, `E2`, `E2b` after the seat deletes them.
- In its place, a six-line absence note in the same form as the file's existing `target:*` note: ownership is the `Area:` line in the `Claim:` comment (pm-dispatch `references/area-lease.md`), no reference reads a `lease:*` label, leftover objects are deleted by a deliberate PM action, and no row is to be re-added.
- The script's header has no family index naming `lease:*` (the first `lease` match in the file is line 213, a `release` word), so nothing else in the file changed. File: 755 to 740 lines (+6 / -21).

Files to read first (by risk): 1. `scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh`, the hunk at line 433 (the only hunk).

### Left to the seat: deleting the label objects

Deleting a label object has no relay op, so this PR deletes nothing and the card stays open. Live `lease:*` set read during this run at head 76d9360e9f (`GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/labels`, paginated): **32 labels**.

- On the card's list (24): `lease:A1`, `lease:A2`, `lease:A3`, `lease:A4`, `lease:A5`, `lease:E1`, `lease:E2`, `lease:E2b`, `lease:o1-A`, `lease:o1-B`, `lease:o1-D`; seat 5's nine: `lease:ux-1`, `lease:ux-2`, `lease:ux-3`, `lease:ai-1`, `lease:data-1`, `lease:data-2`, `lease:pkg-1`, `lease:pkg-2`, `lease:fleet-1`; other seats' areas (confirm first, per the card): `lease:o1-C`, `lease:o3-H`, `lease:o4-A`, `lease:o4-C`.
- Added in the claim: `lease:b1-H` (created 2026-11-19 15:54Z, after the step had retired).
- Live but on neither list (7): `lease:b1-A`, `lease:b1-B`, `lease:b1-F`, `lease:b1-G`, `lease:d7-B`, `lease:d7-C`, `lease:d7-D`. Their owning seats are not recorded on the card; the seat confirms each before deleting.

## Tests

No package touched, so no package build or test is owed. The script's own test surface is `check:pm-label-desc-cap` (its `--self-test` runs the real script under a fake `gh`): exit 0, `50 label descriptions in scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh, all ≤100 characters` (floor 12). `bash -n scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh`: exit 0. No test file names the script (`git grep ensure-pm-labels` over test files: no match). No ablation: no tested behaviour changed.

## Acceptance notes

- `git grep -n 'lease:' -- scripts/pm .github/workflows` after the change: no line seeds, writes or reads a `lease:*` label. The matches left are `Release:`/`release:` prose and `scripts/pm/fleet-token.mjs:521` ("Under the lease:", the token write lease, not a label).
- The remote branch had been deleted when PR #35587 merged, so the first push was a plain `git push -u` of a branch made from `origin/main` a186b2b584; no force push was needed.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `grep -c 'gh label create "lease' scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh` prints `0`, and `pnpm check:pm-label-desc-cap` prints the 50-descriptions line.
